The unwind is two legs and only two are legal, because the squad sits one body above the ten-man penalty threshold and each sale spends one of exactly two permitted moves. binding_gap: Attack, and it tightens rather than loosens once the called sales happen. The goalkeeper position is a single body with no cover, so any goalkeeper problem would be unfixable without a purchase.
